_readme: Where each brochure's per-pattern tire photos come from. Read by scripts/build_images.py.
root     -- the folder Herbert keeps the photos in: one subfolder per brochure, one per pattern inside that.
source   -- the brochure's own photo folder. Every pattern in it is published, whether or not a page is found for it.
borrow   -- other brochures' folders whose patterns also appear on this brochure's pages; only the ones matched to a page are used.
logos    -- folders whose top-level logo files go into the ZIP; defaults to the source folder.
pages    -- page number -> pattern folder name, for pages the automatic match gets wrong. null means no photos for that page.
exclude  -- pattern folders never to publish, with the reason.

exclude.Wolf Pack ATV & UTV/P3266 RUN FLAT: Shows a HI-RUN AT22x11-10 with a different tread, not the WolfPack P3266 25x11.00-12 on the page (2026-09-28).
